messages:
Marta: @Ravi quick check — our HW partners are offering a monthly 'burst credit' pool on top of reserved capacity. Need exact qty + regional caps to fold into the cost model by EOD.

Ravi: Zenith on today's call: 1000 burst GPU-hours/mo per customer. Regional split eu-west-1=400, us-west-2=400, ap-southeast-1=200. Burst consumes before paid spot; if customers exceed credits they pay spot + 20% premium.

Jun: can you confirm how credits are applied when reserved baseline + burst < actual usage? proration rules?

Ravi: sequence from partner: reserved -> burst_credits -> spot_paid. Credits are consumed at the time of ephemeral allocation. No cross-account transfer.

Elena: rough cost-model approach: treat burst credits as "discount units" applied to ephemeral hours. Pseudocode:
```
# effective cost per hour
if usage <= reserved:
  cost = 0
elif usage <= reserved + burst:
  charged_hours = usage - reserved
  cost = max(0, charged_hours * spot_price - min(burst_available, charged_hours) * credit_value)
else:
  charged_hours = usage - reserved - burst_available
  cost = charged_hours * (spot_price * 1.2) + (burst_available * (spot_price - credit_value))
```
(we'll tidy for vectorized calc)

Jun: eviction / preempt behavior? partner ops said burst-backed tasks can be evicted with ~2h notice, no SLA. We should add modeling buffer for lost work.

Marta: good call. treat evictions as an availability factor, not guaranteed capacity. Also confirm partner's change-notice window for credit qty.

Ravi: noted — partner requires 30d notice to change credit allocations. Also credits are not refundable and do not roll between accounts.

Elena: sample CSV format request I want from partner to ingest automatically:
```
region,reserved_hours,burst_credits,spot_price,credit_value,change_notice_days
us-west-2,20000,400,2.50,1.80,30
eu-west-1,18000,400,2.40,1.75,30
ap-southeast-1,15000,200,2.80,1.90,30
```

Jun: for sensitivity runs, assume eviction loss factor of 5%, 10%, 20% and also test spot_price+premium scenarios.

Marta: action items: @Ravi - get the partner CSV and legal note about transferability by tomorrow; @Elena - wire the burst credit logic into the simulator and add eviction knobs; @Jun - run sensitivity grid and post a short matrix. :thumbsup:

MarketplaceBot: Summary created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-1234 — "Burst credit inputs from Zenith" (assignee: Ravi).

Ravi: will upload CSV and a short readme about edge cases (transferability, notice window). Also confirming no joint-announcement language that promises burst availability.

Marta: exactly — we won't include burst commitments in any co-marketing messaging. Marking for SI bundle planning only (internal ops). :no_entry:

Jun: small note for pricing: model credit_value as a per-hour discount (not a price override). Easier math and aligns with partner billing.

Elena: I'll open a PR to the cost-model repo once CSV is in, include unit tests for the 3 scenarios.

Marta: thanks everyone — closing thread after Ravi uploads the file.
